title: Teach your task. Keep control of automation.

chapters.title: Show it what your categories mean.
chapters.text: Want your app to sort messages your way? Start with examples and the right category for each one.

chapters.title: Small task tuning. Visible improvement.
chapters.text: The base model stays fixed. A small task head learns from your labels. Here, that improves the task's accuracy.

chapters.title: Certify with separate examples.
chapters.text: Next, choose an error target. Separate examples check which answers qualify. Those examples never train the task.

chapters.title: Automate qualifying answers. Review the rest.
chapters.text: When an answer qualifies, your app can route it automatically. Otherwise, keep the prediction as a suggestion for review.

chapters.title: Less manual work. A visible review path.
chapters.text: Here, over thirteen hundred messages qualify. Some are still wrong. Keep a review path, and watch for changing traffic.
